findings.text: follow-on: the test hands in-memory plan dicts straight to build_roadmap, _derive_lifecycle and resource_view, so it never exercises the production wiring that attaches section_declarations to the served inventory row (reckon/serve.py:1951) or parses gated_sections from the plan HTML (reckon/_plan_html.py:1239); a regression dropping either would keep this gate green while production reverts to blocking the whole plan.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits 658ffe50f and d8192ddc3 against base 6be3fa597; the split, its three callers, the served section declarations, the two tests and the landing fragment all land inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_section_gate_holds_its_sections.py and the importer arms; the manifest and logs/gate-head.log record the focused gate at 49 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to hold only the named sections when a gate names sections the plan can work around; reckon/roadmap.py:798 split_unpassed_gates returns a naming gate in the section-holding list when the plan still declares a free implementable section, and the three readiness readers consume it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the focused gate 49 passed, the head importer arm 902 passed EXIT=0, the base arm 899 passed with one scaffolding failure, and the negative control red at EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths and the node brief; the five paths in the diff all sit inside the six declared write paths.

justifications.durability: the negative control at logs/negative-control.log reinstates the regression and reddens test_an_ungated_section_keeps_the_plan_unblocked_across_every_reader at :130 with p reading blocked.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_a_section_gate_holds_its_sections.py:123 asserts p unblocked and :148 asserts q, r and t blocked across the roadmap row, the served plan and the MCP view, and logs/gate-head.log records 49 passed EXIT=0.
justifications.fit: split_unpassed_gates sits beside execution_gates at reckon/roadmap.py:798 and follows the module's voice, and no plan, sprint or ticket label appears in any added name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/roadmap.py:815-822 returns a naming gate into the section-holding list while the plan row reads unblocked, matching the deliverable at docs/plans/the-portfolio-reads-true.html:160.
justifications.reuse: split_unpassed_gates composes the existing owners execution_gates and unpassed_gate_blockers (reckon/roadmap.py, reckon/lifecycle.py) rather than duplicating them, and no prior reader scoped a gate to its sections.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 6be3fa597..d8192ddc3 touches exactly five paths, every one inside the declared write paths the manifest lists.
